_comment: Sources whose carve-js reading the grammar does not build yet, per boundary script. Read by scripts/engine-reading-gaps.mjs: an unrecorded difference fails, and so does a recorded source that now matches. Re-measure with UPDATE_ENGINE_READING_GAPS=1.

extension-enclosing-boundaries.reason: Not the carve#4513 closer, which the grammar follows: inside a braced span whose closer sits in the payload, carve-js pairs the opener by the next carve release's inline pairing procedure (the span stays literal), and the next release's block layout (carve#3887) ends a payload line under an indented heading or a footnote's lazy line differently. The grammar still reads both the released way.

caption-block-boundaries.reason: The next carve release's block layout (carve#3887 and the 0.1.14 layout rulings): an indented heading, quote or break line, a `^` line at an item's column and a comment line end an open inline span in a caption differently than the grammar, which still continues the span the released way.

inline-span-audit.reason: The next carve release makes the inline pairing procedure normative (delimiter stack, braced openers, combined tokens, comment-only bodies); the grammar still pairs these delimiters the released way.

inline-reading-boundaries.reason: The next carve release makes the inline pairing procedure normative: an unpaired opener before another opener stays literal (`_*x* q`); the grammar still pairs these delimiters the released way.

block-boundaries.reason: The next carve release's block layout (carve#3887): fences and colon openers in description bodies and fence closers below a nested item's column are owned by a different container; the grammar still folds the lines the released way.

opaque-quote-bands.reason: The next carve release's block layout (carve#3887): over-indented markers in a marker-line opaque quote are owned by a different block; the grammar still folds the lines the released way.
